title: Everyday Phrases — Planning Weekly Meals
scene_zh: 採買清單 · 情境對話
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🍲 實用「規畫一週餐食」必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Planning Weekly Meals
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「規畫一週餐食」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是採買清單：規畫一週的晚餐：翻食譜和行事曆、看哪幾天忙，決定主菜、寫採買清單，把冰箱剩菜排進去，一起煮一鍋湯分裝冷凍，最後把清單貼在冰箱上、算一下預算。400 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'Planning Weekly Meals' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). Planning a week of meals: checking the calendar, choosing main dishes, writing the shopping list, using up leftovers, batch-cooking a pot of soup, and sticking the list on the fridge. 400 lines on repeat, A2 level.
youtube_tags: 規畫一週餐食 英文

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please open the recipe book.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is on the shelf above.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is our weekly calendar?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is beside the fridge.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's check this busy week.
dialogue.zh: 我們來看看這忙碌的一週。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Monday looks very full already.
dialogue.zh: 星期一看起來已經很滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which days are busy this week?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three days look busy this week.
dialogue.zh: 這週有三天看起來很忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should we cook tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Something simple from this book.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our calendar has many notes.
dialogue.zh: 我們的月曆上有很多註記。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's read them one by one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Monday has a late meeting.
dialogue.zh: 星期一有一場晚一點的會議。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we eat something quick.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we plan the whole week?
dialogue.zh: 我們能把整週都規劃好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we have time now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is Tuesday free for cooking?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, Tuesday is very busy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is Wednesday marked red?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼星期三被標成紅色？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is my late work day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's turn to the soup page.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: These pages are a little sticky.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you like this recipe?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It looks easy and cheap.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long should it cook?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About forty minutes, not long.
dialogue.zh: 大約四十分鐘，不會太久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This book is falling apart.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We should tape it carefully.
dialogue.zh: 我們該小心地把它黏好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thursday is busy for both.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we need a simple dinner.
dialogue.zh: 所以我們需要簡單的晚餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do we have at home?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rice, eggs, and some vegetables.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday looks completely free.
dialogue.zh: 星期五看起來完全空著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we can cook properly.
dialogue.zh: 那我們可以好好煮一頓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we write a shopping list?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Later, after we choose the meals.
dialogue.zh: 等一下，等我們選好菜色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This page has a nice photo.
dialogue.zh: 這一頁有一張好看的照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The chicken dish looks delicious.
dialogue.zh: 這道雞肉料理看起來很好吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which recipe is the easiest?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Page ten has tomato pasta.
dialogue.zh: 第十頁有番茄義大利麵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our calendar is quite crowded.
dialogue.zh: 我們的月曆排得滿滿的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next week is calmer, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's mark the cooking days.
dialogue.zh: 我們把要煮飯的日子標出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will use a blue pen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday morning is for the market.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, it is very near.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunday evening is family dinner.
dialogue.zh: 星期日晚上是家庭晚餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We cook a bigger meal then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the week is clear.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Time to choose the meals.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the book easy to read?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the words are simple.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many recipes do we have?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Too many for one single week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Monday is always the hardest day.
dialogue.zh: 星期一總是最累的一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can cook something very quick.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please circle the busy days.
dialogue.zh: 請把忙碌的日子圈起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.
dialogue.zh: 星期二、星期三和星期四。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you work late on Wednesday?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, until eight at night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When can we go shopping?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saturday morning works for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This recipe needs many things.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can skip some of them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is on Friday evening?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing, the evening is free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our weekends are usually quiet.
dialogue.zh: 我們的週末通常很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we cook and relax together.
dialogue.zh: 那我們就一起煮飯放鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you read this small writing?
dialogue.zh: 你看得懂這小小的字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the letters are tiny.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The calendar page is old.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe we buy a new one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which night is best for soup?
dialogue.zh: 哪一個晚上最適合煮湯？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sunday night is cool and calm.
dialogue.zh: 星期天晚上涼爽又清閒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please put the book here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The kitchen table is fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we have anything on Tuesday?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a short phone call.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why did we stop planning meals?
dialogue.zh: 我們為什麼不再規劃餐食了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Life got busy for both of us.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪf ɡɑt ˈbɪzi fɔr boʊθ əv ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 我們兩個的生活都變忙了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How about cooking on Thursday?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thursday is tight but possible.
dialogue.zh: 星期四很趕，但還是可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those photos make me hungry.
dialogue.zh: 那些照片讓我看得都餓了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, especially the noodle page.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，尤其是麵那一頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please check the calendar again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everything matches what we said.
dialogue.zh: 一切都跟我們說的一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This week has three busy days.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we keep dinners very simple.
dialogue.zh: 所以我們的晚餐要很簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we plan breakfast too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breakfast is always the same thing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who wrote these tiny notes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your mother wrote them last year.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is Saturday good for the market?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is open early.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now we choose four meals.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four meals fit this busy week.
dialogue.zh: 四道菜剛好應付這忙碌的一週。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The busy days are clear now.
dialogue.zh: 忙碌的日子現在清楚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, we can plan the food.
dialogue.zh: 好，我們可以來規劃吃的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our week looks manageable.
dialogue.zh: 我們這一週看起來還應付得來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small plans make life easier.
dialogue.zh: 小小的計畫讓生活輕鬆些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should we cook this week?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can make chicken on Monday.
dialogue.zh: 我們星期一可以做雞肉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is chicken okay for the main dish?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈtʃɪkɪn oʊˈkeɪ fɔr ðə meɪn dɪʃ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, chicken sounds good to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which vegetables go with the chicken?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Carrots and potatoes work very well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we have carrots in the fridge?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi hæv ˈkærəts ɪn ðə frɪdʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 我們冰箱裡有紅蘿蔔嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we finished them last night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please write carrots on the list.
dialogue.zh: 請把紅蘿蔔寫在清單上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will write them down now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much chicken should we buy?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two kilos should be enough today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you add tomatoes to the list?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju æd təˈmeɪtoʊz tu ðə lɪst?/
dialogue.zh: 你可以把番茄加進清單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I am adding them now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about rice for the side?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rice is already in the cupboard.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there any fish left in there?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ˈɛni fɪʃ lɛft ɪn ðɛr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, there is some fish left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should eat the leftovers first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the fridge is very full.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How old are the leftovers there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are from Tuesday, still fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What can we make with them?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can make a simple soup.
dialogue.zh: 我們可以煮個簡單的湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which night is free for cooking?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friday night looks free this week.
dialogue.zh: 這週五晚上看起來有空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who will go to the market?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can go after work tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we buy the vegetables early?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the market closes at six.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do they sell fresh fish?
dialogue.zh: 他們在哪裡賣新鮮的魚？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The small shop near the corner.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they still have fresh fish?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the fish was sold out.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then what else can we cook?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We could cook eggs with tomatoes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds easy and very cheap.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is also quick to make.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many eggs do we need?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six eggs are enough for us.
dialogue.zh: 六顆蛋對我們來說夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there milk on the list?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and also some bread.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which fruit should we get this time?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ frut ʃʊd wi ɡɛt ðɪs taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 這次我們該買什麼水果？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Apples are cheap and last long.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please add apples to the list.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The list is getting longer now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we really need all this?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we can cross some out.
dialogue.zh: 不用，我們可以劃掉一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should we cross off first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do not need more rice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's check the list again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everything looks right to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe we should cook fish Thursday.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shop had no fish left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we can choose another main dish.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi kæn tʃuz əˈnʌðər meɪn dɪʃ./
dialogue.zh: 那我們可以選另一道主菜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pork with potatoes sounds very good.
dialogue.zh: 豬肉配馬鈴薯聽起來很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are pork and potatoes still cheap?
dialogue.zh: 豬肉和馬鈴薯還便宜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they are cheap this month.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the market open on Thursday?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it opens every morning early.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you buy the pork tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can, after my morning class.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much pork do we need?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One kilo is enough for us.
dialogue.zh: 一公斤對我們來說夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please write pork on the list.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I wrote it under the chicken.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we also buy some onions?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, onions make the dish sweeter.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there garlic in the kitchen?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a little garlic left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We still have rice and eggs.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we only need meat and vegetables.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi ˈoʊnli nid mit ænd ˈvɛdʒtəbəlz./
dialogue.zh: 所以我們只需要肉和蔬菜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fridge still has Tuesday leftovers.
dialogue.zh: 冰箱裡還有星期二的剩菜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We must finish them before shopping.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we eat leftovers on Wednesday?
dialogue.zh: 我們星期三可以吃剩菜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, then we cook on Thursday.
dialogue.zh: 可以，那我們星期四再煮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That plan saves us some money.
dialogue.zh: 這個計畫幫我們省點錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It also saves us some time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your handwriting on the list is clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ˈhændˌraɪtɪŋ ɑn ðə lɪst ɪz klɪr./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, I wrote it carefully.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe we should add some fruit too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi wi ʃʊd æd sʌm frut tu./
dialogue.zh: 也許我們也該加點水果。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bananas are on sale this week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's put bananas at the bottom.
dialogue.zh: 我們把香蕉寫在最下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the list is almost done.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we forget the cooking oil?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, there is still some oil.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are there enough potatoes at home?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only two, so add more please.
dialogue.zh: 只有兩顆，請再多加一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write three kilos of potatoes then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three kilos may be too heavy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then write two kilos instead.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two kilos is a better choice.
dialogue.zh: 兩公斤是比較好的選擇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should we keep the list?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the fridge door, of course.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That way we both remember it.
dialogue.zh: 這樣我們兩個都會記得。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is easy to see.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who will cook the pork Thursday?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will cook it after work.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, the plan is ready now.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，計畫現在準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's eat the leftovers tonight.
dialogue.zh: 我們今晚把剩菜吃掉吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us make a big soup today.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs meɪk ə bɪɡ sup təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我們今天來煮一大鍋湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, we can eat it later.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which pot should I use for this?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ pɑt ʃʊd aɪ juz fɔr ðɪs?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tall pot holds the most.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What vegetables go into the soup?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Carrots, onions and some small potatoes.
dialogue.zh: 紅蘿蔔、洋蔥和一些小馬鈴薯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I cut the carrots first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, cut them into small pieces.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much water do we add?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fill it up to this line.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who will stir the pot tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You stir, and I will watch.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When do we put in the beans?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn du wi pʊt ɪn ðə binz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add them after the water boils.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why does the soup smell so good?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ dʌz ðə sup smɛl soʊ ɡʊd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Because the onions are cooking slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it need any salt now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a little, we can taste later.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ə ˈlɪtəl wi kæn teɪst ˈleɪtər/
dialogue.zh: 加一點就好，之後可以再試味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where are the small glass boxes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are above the fridge.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many boxes do we need?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four boxes are enough for us.
dialogue.zh: 四個盒子對我們來說夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we eat some soup tonight?
dialogue.zh: 我們今晚可以先喝一些湯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, the rest goes in boxes.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv kɔrs ðə rɛst ɡoʊz ɪn ˈbɑksəz/
dialogue.zh: 當然，剩下的裝進盒子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should the soup cool before storing?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, warm soup spoils in the fridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wɔrm sup spɔɪlz ɪn ðə frɪdʒ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long can we keep it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About three days is still safe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which box is for Monday lunch?
dialogue.zh: 哪一盒是星期一的午餐？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The box with the blue lid.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we write the date on top?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi raɪt ðə deɪt ɑn tɑp?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要在上面寫日期嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, write it with this pen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if the fridge gets too full?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf ðə frɪdʒ ɡɛts tu fʊl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we freeze two boxes outside.
dialogue.zh: 那我們就把兩盒放到外面冷凍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the freezer cold enough for soup?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈfrizər koʊld ɪˈnʌf fɔr sup?/
dialogue.zh: 冷凍庫的溫度夠冰湯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is very cold in there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do we heat it up again?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du wi hit ɪt ʌp əˈɡɛn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put one box in hot water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I use the small microwave instead?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ juz ðə smɔl ˈmaɪkroʊwev ɪnˈstɛd?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以改用小微波爐嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but cover the box first.
dialogue.zh: 可以，但先把盒子蓋起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why should we cover the box?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The soup will splash and spill.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I stir it while heating?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, stir it once in the middle.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs stɜr ɪt wʌns ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the soup taste the same later?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə sup teɪst ðə seɪm ˈleɪtər?/
dialogue.zh: 這湯之後喝起來一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It tastes even better the next day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt teɪsts ˈivən ˈbɛtər ðə nɛkst deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 隔天喝起來反而更好喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who cleans the pot and boxes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We wash them together after dinner.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are there enough boxes for everyone?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one box each is fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The soup is done, let us taste.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sup ɪz dʌn lɛt ʌs teɪst/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It needs a little more salt.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we add pepper too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but only a small amount.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now we fill the boxes carefully.
dialogue.zh: 現在我們小心地把盒子裝滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave some room at the top.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should each box hold the same amount?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd itʃ bɑks hoʊld ðə seɪm əˈmaʊnt?/
dialogue.zh: 每一盒都要裝一樣多嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that makes heating much easier.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should we put the labels?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stick them on the box lids.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should the labels say?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write the day and the kind.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we keep one in the fridge?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi kip wʌn ɪn ðə frɪdʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要留一盒在冰箱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that one is for tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which box should we eat first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The oldest box goes out first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When does the soup go bad?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: After four days it is not safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæftər fɔr deɪz ɪt ɪz nɑt seɪf/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How can we remember the date?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The label on the lid helps.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it fine to freeze this soup?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt faɪn tu friz ðɪs sup?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It freezes very well, in fact.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we thaw it in the fridge?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi θɔ ɪt ɪn ðə frɪdʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要在冰箱裡解凍嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, move it down the night before.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs muv ɪt daʊn ðə naɪt bɪˈfɔr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if we forget to move it?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf wi fərˈɡɛt tu muv ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我們忘了移下來呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then use warm water to thaw.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the soup need more time then?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə sup nid mɔr taɪm ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 那湯需要多一點時間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, give it ten more minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we bring soup to work?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it saves money and time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we have a bag for it?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi hæv ə bæɡ fɔr ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The blue bag keeps it cold.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we warm lunch at work?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du wi wɔrm lʌntʃ æt wɜrk?/
dialogue.zh: 我們在公司哪裡加熱午餐？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a microwave in the kitchen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə ˈmaɪkroʊwev ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃən/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long should it heat there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two minutes is usually enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the soup taste good at noon?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə sup teɪst ɡʊd æt nun?/
dialogue.zh: 這湯中午喝起來好喝嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It tastes like a warm meal.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who takes the last box home?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can take that one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is soup enough for a whole dinner?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz sup ɪˈnʌf fɔr ə hoʊl ˈdɪnər?/
dialogue.zh: 湯夠當一頓完整的晚餐嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add bread and it is fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which bread goes well with this?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The dark bread from the market.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why not cook rice with it too?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ nɑt kʊk raɪs wɪð ɪt tu?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rice is quick and fills us up.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪs ɪz kwɪk ænd fɪlz ʌs ʌp/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you cook this soup again?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, next week with more beans.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are all the boxes in the fridge?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ɔl ðə ˈbɑksəz ɪn ðə frɪdʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 所有盒子都放進冰箱了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three are, one is frozen.
dialogue.zh: 三盒在冰箱，一盒冷凍了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should we put the list?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tape it on the fridge door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we have any tape here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is some in the drawer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the tape strong enough for paper?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə teɪp strɔŋ ɪˈnʌf fər ˈpeɪpər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It holds paper very well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I add the date?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, put the week number too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What day does this week start?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It starts on Monday morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many dinners do we plan?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We plan four dinners this week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we eating out this week?
dialogue.zh: 這週我們會在外面吃嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only once, on Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us check the list again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everything we need is written.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we forget the eggs?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the eggs are on the list.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə ɛɡz ɑr ɑn ðə lɪst./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now let us count the total cost.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ lɛt ʌs kaʊnt ðə ˈtoʊtəl kɔst./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have the receipts right here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is the chicken?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is cheaper than last week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we stay under our budget?
dialogue.zh: 我們能控制在預算內嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I think we can do it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the total for everything?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is on the list.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the total include the vegetables?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the vegetables are included.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did you put the receipt?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is inside my coat pocket.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we buy the bigger rice bag?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi baɪ ðə ˈbɪɡər raɪs bæɡ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bigger bag lasts longer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the market cheaper on Sunday?
dialogue.zh: 星期日市場比較便宜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sunday prices are usually lower.
dialogue.zh: 星期日的價格通常比較低。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who is paying for the groceries?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We share the cost together.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When do we go shopping?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We go tomorrow after work.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the fridge be full again?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It will be very full.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need anything else today?
dialogue.zh: 今天還需要別的東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We need nothing else today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us take a picture of it.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs teɪk ə ˈpɪktʃər əv ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, my phone is here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why do we keep the list?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we remember what to buy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you happy with the plan?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I am very happy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we call it a night?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, let us rest now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the list look neat up there?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə lɪst lʊk nit ʌp ðɛr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It looks perfect on the fridge.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you see it from the table?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju si ɪt frʌm ðə ˈteɪbəl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I can see it clearly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What else should we write down?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing else comes to mind.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the pen now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The pen is on the counter.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do you feel about this?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I feel calm and ready.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is our plan simple enough?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is simple and clear.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will we cook every night?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will cook most nights.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we save money this way?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We save money every week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we done with the planning?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we are finally done.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we close the notebook?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us close it together.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who will cook on Monday night?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You cook and I wash.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When is our next shopping trip?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our next trip is tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is the kitchen so clean?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We cleaned it this morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the leftovers still in there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They sit on the top shelf.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us check the freezer too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The freezer is almost empty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did we put in the soup?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dɪd wi pʊt ɪn ðə sup?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We put carrots and beans.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the soup need more salt?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It tastes fine to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long will the soup last?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It will last three days.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we freeze half of it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we can freeze half.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which container should we use?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the glass one please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we turn off the light?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the kitchen is ready.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there anything left to do?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everything is finished for tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you feel good about tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I feel good and relaxed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we go to bed now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is getting late.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, rest well.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, sleep well.

issues.note: 「Let's eat the leftovers tonight.」的 tonight 與 172-175「週三吃剩菜、週四才開煮」的行程略有張力：若本景從週一晚起算，週一晚餐已排 chicken（101）。可合理化為「今晚先把冰箱剩菜清掉」的一般性提醒，非硬矛盾；若求嚴絲合縫可寫 Wednesday night。
「We plan four dinners this week.」與全篇可數晚餐（週日 family dinner、週一 chicken、週三 leftovers、週四 pork、週五 soup）差一頓；但 046 已明示週日 family dinner 屬既有慣例，094/095 的 four meals 指本週新規劃的四次下廚（週一、週三、週四、週五），口語可通，不列 error。
「Monday looks very full already.」與 054「Monday is always the hardest day.」屬同一事實的兩次陳述，密度偏高但都自然；開頭詞分布尚可，重複句為 0。

review.summary_zh: 本輪三處已確實修好：007 的「Three days look busy this week.」與 057/086（Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday）及 087/097 完全一致；125 的「Friday night looks free」與 032/065/066 相符，未再把週一說成有空（064/065 僅指週五）；144 改為 add apples，不再與 141-142 已加的 bread 重複。全篇「哪幾天忙／哪晚有空／買什麼」自洽：忙日固定為週二、週三、週四（週一另有 late meeting，僅被稱為 the hardest day），採買日固定週六早晨，主菜為 chicken（週一）–leftovers（週三）–pork+potatoes（週四）–soup（週五），週六外食一次。殘留僅為口語級鬆散，非 error。
